notes_for_editor: Only one primary item (April 1922 Suffolk County News, transcribed on the Forest Lookouts site) places a 90-foot tower on the club grounds. No build date, builder, removal date or move is found; the story does not claim the move happened. The 1922 item spells the club 'Sportsman Club'; the story uses the Wikipedia name. Search results about Telescope Hill (Brookhaven, 1918-1960) are a different tower and are not used. Consider a Town of Islip historian or Oakdale Historical Society check before publishing a stronger claim.
